intro: Beginnings is a rite of passage for fledgling Alliance warlocks starting in Dun Morogh. Under the begrudging tutelage of Alamar Grimm, novices are dispatched to harvest magical feather charms from nearby Frostmane troll novices to prove their competence before mastering the art of summoning an imp.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You must be the new warlock everyone's been whispering about. Must be someone's taken a liking to you if they've asked me to take time away from my research to start your training.
Don't worry, I won't hold it against you.
The simplest of the summoning spells you will learn is that of the imp. Before I impart this to you, however, you must prove that you have the necessary magical and physical ability.
Bring me three feather charms from the frostmane novices from the cave to the southwest.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Those feather charms the novices carry have some sort of magical power to them. It will be interesting to research them. I wouldn't have expected it from the trolls.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good, very good! You've done well, friend. Perhaps the interest that is being shown in you is deserved, after all.

That'll be for the others to decide--assuming your imp doesn't overpower you and nip your career in the bud. For now, I'm satisfied that you'll probably survive your first few months as an adventurer.
A word about the imp, friend. As a traveler knows, don't let its size fool you, its magic can be very dangerous.
